source: Reference (Mermaid bundle in Chromium) ELK input per flowchart fixture of e2e/diagrams/flowchart, captured by the port-m5-flowchart-render worktree (target/geometry/flowchart/<fixture>/elk-input.json). The name is the fixture path relative to e2e/diagrams/flowchart with / replaced by -. Config: only fixtures listed in config are not run with the defaults.

fixtures.name: nightly-check-elk-container-algorithms-elk-box-layout-with-edges

fixtures.name: nightly-check-elk-container-algorithms-elk-subgraph-with-box-algorithm
fixtures.excluded: container layout elk.box: decision 0006 falls back to the diagram algorithm, so the reference input names elk.box on the container
